messages:
Maria Paredes: Hey team — quick proposal for the cross-func weekly: try an "agenda-keeper" rotation to handle agenda ownership + decision-log upkeep. Thoughts?

Jake Liu: sounds good. do you mean 1 person each week?

Maria Paredes: yea 1 person/week for a 4-week cycle, then repeat. keeper would: collate RFC/design items, set 2 priorities, keep the decision log link, and ping owners.

Samir Khan: I like. keeps meetings lean. can we make it optional for weeks with light agendas?

Nora Chen: happy to trial as keeper for next week if folks are ok. I can also do the initial template.

Maria Paredes: awesome, @Nora that would be great. can you post the template and add to the confluence page? (link: https://confluence.redwood.internal/crossfunc/agenda)

Nora Chen: sure. draft below — feedback welcome:

```
Agenda (45m):
- 5m quick updates (team/blocks)
- 15m RFC / design review (owner: assign ahead)
- 15m roadmap / priority disputes (facilitated)
- 5m action items + next keeper nomination
```

Jake Liu: nit: maybe make RFC slot 20m when there are 2 docs; otherwise can slide. Also suggest adding a "pre-read" tag so folks know when to come prepared.

Samir Khan: +1 pre-read. also we should pin the most recent decision log at top of the doc. last time we lost context across swaps.

Maria Paredes: good call. keeper responsibilities (short):
- update agenda page & attach pre-reads
- pick 2 priority topics and owner for each
- capture decisions and link to decision-log after meeting
- follow-up with action owners

Nora Chen: I'll set up the calendar invite for Tues 9am next week, add agenda template, and nominate Jake for week 2 if no objections.

Jake Liu: fine by me. if anyone prefers not to be nominated just say so.

Samir Khan: quick logistics — can we add a "triage" slot every other week for quick incident/ops items? 10min.

Maria Paredes: yes — alternate weeks we add a 10m triage/ops slot right after quick updates. Nora, adjust template accordingly.

Nora Chen: done. calendar invite created and shared. agenda page updated and decision-log link pinned. invite: https://calendar.redwood.internal/event/abc123

agenda-bot: Reminder: meeting invite created by Nora Chen for Tue 9:00 AM. React with :hand: to volunteer for future keeper slots or reply here to decline.

Maria Paredes: thanks everyone. Action items: Nora — run week 1, Jake — week 2, Samir — add triage cadence suggestion in the doc, Maria — update rotation table on confluence. We'll reassess after 4 cycles.

Jake Liu: 👍 will add a short checklist for keepers to the doc (pre-reads, file locs, decision-log link).

Samir Khan: 👍 thanks.

Nora Chen: done — checklist and template live. I'll collect feedback after next meeting.

Maria Paredes: closing loop — if no objections by EOD I'll lock in the rotation and publish in weekly update. :thumbsup:
